readme:
# mobile.de Scraper: Car Listings, Prices and Dealers

Get vehicle listings from mobile.de search result pages as clean rows. Set your filters on mobile.de, copy the address of the result page, paste it into the actor and run. Each row has the make, model, variant, price, price rating, first registration, mileage, power, fuel, transmission, body type, colour, previous owners, dealer, location and photos. No login is needed.

## What you get

- One row per vehicle listing, in the order the site shows them.
- Prices as numbers, with the currency and the price rating label the site shows (for example "Sehr guter Preis").
- Technical data: first registration, mileage in km, power in kW and PS, fuel, transmission, body type, colour, engine size, seats, doors, emission class, weight and previous owners where the site gives them.
- Seller data: seller type (dealer or private), dealer name, postal code, city, dealer rating and review count, and the dealer phone numbers that the result page carries.
- Photos shown on the result card, the number of photos the listing has, badges, highlight lines and manufacturer seals.

## Input

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | One or more search result addresses from `suchen.mobile.de`. Required. |
| `maxResults` | Most listings to return across all addresses. Default 50. |
| Connection settings | Leave the default. The actor picks the connection it needs. |

Filters are set on mobile.de itself: choose make, model, price, first registration, mileage, fuel, location and radius there, then copy the address from the browser. The actor does not build filter addresses from separate input fields, because the result page does not show how each filter maps to an address parameter.

Example:

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://suchen.mobile.de/fahrzeuge/search.html?isSearchRequest=true&s=Car&vc=Car"],
  "maxResults": 48
}
```

The actor starts at the first page of the address (or at the page given by `pageNumber` in it) and moves on to the next pages until it has `maxResults` listings or the search has no more pages. A search shows at most 50 pages, which is about 1,200 listings. To get more, split the search into smaller ones (for example by price range) and add each address to `startUrls`.

## Output

One row per listing. A sample row:

```json
{
  "id": "47014784608160",
  "url": "https://suchen.mobile.de/fahrzeuge/details.html?id=47014784608160",
  "title": "Volkswagen Golf",
  "make": "Volkswagen",
  "model": "Golf",
  "variant": "6 R 2.0TSI 265PS DSG Cabriolet Navi DCC DAB",
  "price": 21999,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "price_rating": "Erhöhter Preis",
  "first_registration": "07/2014",
  "mileage_km": 115264,
  "power_kw": 195,
  "power_hp": 265,
  "fuel": "Benzin",
  "transmission": "Automatik",
  "body_type": "Cabrio/Roadster",
  "colour": "Blau",
  "owners": 3,
  "seller_type": "dealer",
  "dealer_name": "Autohaus Klann GmbH",
  "dealer_zip": "14513",
  "dealer_city": "Teltow",
  "dealer_rating": 4,
  "dealer_review_count": 173,
  "image_urls": ["https://img.classistatic.de/api/v1/mo-prod/images/4d/4dfc2e80-2f97-4dd1-bb76-7dc189dc0ba0?rule=mo-1600"],
  "image_count": 45,
  "highlights": ["Tempo R-CAM Navi", "Bi-Xenon SHZ", "DYNAUDIO Sound"],
  "placement": "regular",
  "position": 5,
  "page": 1
}
```

Fields the page does not show are `null`. Lists that are empty are `[]`.

## Pricing

You pay per run start and per listing delivered.

| Event | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Listing scraped (`mobile-de-listing-result`) | $0.001 per listing ($1.00 per 1,000) |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first delivered rows. A run that delivers nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops cleanly when the limit is reached and reports how many listings it delivered.

## Limitations

- Only data that the search result page shows is returned. Details that exist only on the single vehicle page (full description, equipment list, VIN, all photos) are not part of this actor.
- The result page has no listing date, so `listing_date` is always `null`.
- Search filters are not offered as separate input fields. Use `startUrls` with an address you copied from mobile.de.
- A search shows at most 50 pages. The number of results the site reports for a search is returned in `search_results_total`.
- Sponsored and top listings can repeat between pages. The actor returns each listing once per run.
- Private sellers: the result page does not show a private seller's name or phone number, so those fields are `null` for private listings.
- Dealer phone numbers are included for dealer listings when the result page data carries them.
- Pages take a few seconds each, so a run of 48 listings takes about a minute.
- The site can change its page layout. If a page cannot be read, the run stops with a clear status message and nothing is charged for it.
- Only the German site (`suchen.mobile.de`) is supported.

## FAQ

**Do I need a mobile.de account?** No. The actor reads public search result pages.

**How do I filter by make, price or location?** Set the filters on mobile.de, copy the address from the browser and paste it into `startUrls`.

**How many listings can I get from one search?** Up to about 1,200 (50 pages of 24). Split larger searches into smaller ones.

**Why are some fields empty?** The card shows different details for different vehicles. For example, new cars have no first registration, and only some listings show consumption values.

**Is a listing returned twice?** No. Each listing id is returned once per run, even when it appears on several pages.

**What happens if the run is stopped and restarted?** The actor saves its progress after every batch. A restarted run continues where it stopped and does not charge twice for rows it already delivered.

**Can I get the price as a number?** Yes. `price` is a number and `currency` is a separate field.
